title: Bitewell chews: the breath test (real owner, signed release)

product.name: Bitewell Dental Chews

hook.text: POV: your dog's breath enters first.

shots.caption: one a day. she thinks it's a treat.

notes: Real customer: signed release and proof of purchase on file; paid partnership stated in speech and on screen (FTC Endorsement Guides, 16 CFR Part 255, 2023 revision).
Only shot 4 is generated; the label says b-roll so viewers do not read the presenter as synthetic.
No 'vet recommended' or plaque-reduction percentage: no study on file, so the script stays with what the owner saw.
